The Incident Between Hadhrat Ali (RA) and another Person Concerning Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Is'haaq reports that a man once came to Hadhrat Ali (RA) and said, "Uthmaan (RA) is in Jahannam." "What makes you say this?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) enquired. The man replied, "Because he had started many new practices." "Tell me," Hadhrat Ali (RA) said to the man, "If you had a daughter, would you marry her without consultation?" When the man said that he would not, Hadhrat Ali (RA) continued, "Do you think that there could be an opinion better than the opinion Rasulullaah ﷺ had concerning (the marriage of) his two daughters? Now tell me this about Rasulullaah ﷺ. Whenever he intended to do something, would he or would he not ask Allaah for the best course to take?" The man replied, "Of course. Rasulullaah ﷺ would certainly ask Allaah for the best course to take." Questioning the man further, Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "Would Allaah then choose the best course for Rasulullaah ﷺ or not?" "Indeed," the man responded, "Allaah would definitely choose the best course for Rasulullaah ﷺ." Hadhrat Ali (RA) then said, "Now tell me this about Rasulullaah ﷺ. Did Allaah not select Uthmaan (RA) to marry the (two) daughters of Rasulullaah ﷺ? I have thought about having you executed but Allaah has decided otherwise. Remember this well! I swear by Allaah that should you ever say anything else (other than what I have explained to you), I shall have you executed."[^2]
The Statement of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) about Someone who Complained about Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)

Hadhrat Saalim reports that his father once met one of the Sahabah (RA) who had a problem with his speech and could therefore not express himself clearly. When he complained about Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "By Allaah! I do not know what you are saying. Nevertheless, O assembly of Muhammad ﷺ's companions, you all know well that during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ, we would always be saying, 'Abu Bakr, Umar and Uthmaan' (their names were always taken together because all respected them most highly). However, now that wealth has become a priority, it is only when he gives (someone a share that the person is pleased with him)."[^3]
The Du'aa of Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) is Accepted Against Someone who Reviled Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Talha (RA) and Hadhrat Zubayr (RA)
